start: Not signed in, no gym, Settings, Your data

user_sees: Caption 'Deletes everything on this phone and starts over from the welcome screen.'
Sheet 'Erase all data?' with 'Every workout, record, routine, body entry, photo and video, your gym link, and your settings. This phone goes back to new.'
Button 'Erase everything'
'Erasing…' then the first screen 'Get stronger every week'
must_not: Photos or videos left in the app's storage

start: Signed in to a MettleUp account

user_sees: 'What do you want to erase?'
'Your workouts are on this phone and saved in your MettleUp account.'
'Erase this phone only' and 'Erase this phone and delete my MettleUp account'

steps.action: Tap 'Erase this phone and delete my MettleUp account'

'Your MettleUp account and everything saved in it are deleted too. This cannot be undone.'
'Erase and delete'
must_not: The phone erased while the account stays

user_sees: The first screen
must_not: The account copy still on the server

steps.action: Choose 'Erase this phone and delete my MettleUp account' and confirm
user_sees: 'Could not delete your MettleUp account, so nothing was erased. Check your internet and try again.'
must_not: An empty phone with a full account

steps.action: Tap 'Erase everything' when the database cannot be wiped
user_sees: 'Could not erase your data. Nothing was deleted. Please try again.'

steps.action: Erase when a step outside the database fails
user_sees: Words naming what was left behind, and a way to start over
must_not: A silent welcome screen with files left

steps.action: Choose 'Erase this phone only' and confirm
user_sees: The first screen
Earlier line 'Your saved copy on MettleUp stays. It comes back when you sign in again.'
The workouts back from the account
